readScript:
printf "home %s
" "$HOME"
printf "system %s
" "$(uname -s)"
printf "arch %s
" "$(uname -m)"
printf "user %s
" "$(id -un)"
shell=$(getent passwd "$(id -un)" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f7); shell=${shell##*/}; shell=${shell:-${SHELL##*/}}; shell=${shell:-bash}
printf "shell %s
" "$shell"
env -u BASH_ENV bash --noprofile --norc -c 'printf "path %s
" "$PATH"; printf "store:CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR %s
" "$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR"; printf "store:CODEX_HOME %s
" "$CODEX_HOME"' 2>/dev/null
printf "cpu %s
" "$(nproc 2>/dev/null || sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
printf "memkb %s
" "$(awk '/MemTotal/{print $2}' /proc/meminfo 2>/dev/null || echo $(( $(sysctl -n hw.memsize 2>/dev/null || echo 0) / 1024 )))"
factsScript:
printf "pretty %s
" "$(sed -n 's/^PRETTY_NAME=//p' /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null | head -1 | tr -d '"')"
printf "mac %s
" "$(sw_vers -productVersion 2>/dev/null)"
printf "kernel %s %s
" "$(uname -s)" "$(uname -r)"
printf "uptime %s
" "$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null)"
printf "boot %s
" "$(sysctl -n kern.boottime 2>/dev/null)"
printf "home %s
" "$HOME"
sudoRead:
if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then echo WSP_SUDO root
elif ! command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo WSP_SUDO none
elif said=$(LC_ALL=C sudo -n -v 2>&1 && LC_ALL=C sudo -n -l bash -c true 2>&1); then echo WSP_SUDO free
else case "$said" in *"must have a tty"*) echo WSP_SUDO tty ;; *) echo WSP_SUDO asks ;; esac; fi
putBytesScript:
set -e
umask 077
mkdir -p '/home/maya/.wsp'
cat > '/home/maya/.wsp/daemon.tgz.wsp-in-abababababab'
[ "$(wc -c < '/home/maya/.wsp/daemon.tgz.wsp-in-abababababab' | tr -d ' ')" = 5 ] || { rm -f '/home/maya/.wsp/daemon.tgz.wsp-in-abababababab'; echo WSP_BYTES_SHORT; exit 1; }
mv -f '/home/maya/.wsp/daemon.tgz.wsp-in-abababababab' '/home/maya/.wsp/daemon.tgz'
echo WSP_BYTES_OK

set -e
umask 077
mkdir -p '.'
cat > 'file.t'
[ "$(wc -c < 'file.t' | tr -d ' ')" = 0 ] || { rm -f 'file.t'; echo WSP_BYTES_SHORT; exit 1; }
mv -f 'file.t' 'file'
echo WSP_BYTES_OK

set -e
umask 077
mkdir -p '/it'\''s here'
cat > '/it'\''s here/f.t'
[ "$(wc -c < '/it'\''s here/f.t' | tr -d ' ')" = 12 ] || { rm -f '/it'\''s here/f.t'; echo WSP_BYTES_SHORT; exit 1; }
mv -f '/it'\''s here/f.t' '/it'\''s here/f'
echo WSP_BYTES_OK
